description: List bundled Cursor skills and agents from cursor-catalog.json with optional filters (platform, technology, utility). Use before install to discover ids and descriptions. Does not copy files.

platform.description: Filter by platform tags (e.g. runrunit, github). AND with other category filters.

project_root.description: Optional absolute path to mcp-runrunit package root. If omitted, resolves near the installed package.

technology.description: Filter by technology tags (e.g. react, typescript).

utility.description: Filter by utility tags (e.g. workflow, evidence, quality).

name: runrunit_list_cursor_catalog
